messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 5xx spike detected for Helios Labs (dedicated-us-east-2 pool). 5m error rate: 17%. Auto-fallback to model-curie-small triggered. Incident ID INC-1751012345. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/embeddings-5xx

oncall-alex: ack. I'm on it — pulling logs + checking autoscaler. @sre-jordan can you look at node health (gpunode-*), and check for OOM / kernel errors? Paging ops on high. :rotating_light:

sre-jordan: seeing repeated CUDA driver WARNs on gpunode-14 and 15, and a couple of kernel OOM traces. Suspect memory pressure + burst workload from Helios batched job. Starting soft-restart of affected nodes and adding +2 warm nodes to pool. Rerouting a portion of traffic to dedicated-fallback-1 to reduce pressure.

oncall-alex: executed scale + reroute. Commands run:
```
# scale up warm pool
kubectl scale deployment/warm-serving --replicas=6 -n inference
# redirect traffic
redwood route update --pool us-east-2 --target dedicated-fallback-1 --selector account=helios
```
Error rate dropping: 17% -> 6% (3m). Note: fallback uses a smaller quantized variant — possible quality regressions for some embeddings. Holding for stabilization, will post timeline + affected accounts.

cs-lina: draft Helios customer notice (please sanity-check):
```
Subject: Service degradation affecting embeddings (Helios Labs) — 12:02–12:18 UTC

Hi team,

We detected degraded availability of Redwood embeddings in your dedicated pool between ~12:02 and 12:18 UTC. During this window some requests returned errors or timed out; functionality that relies on embeddings (search/indexing, similarity features) may have seen failures or increased latency.

What we did: we routed your traffic to a fallback serving pool and scaled additional warm nodes to restore capacity. This mitigated the outage by 12:18 UTC; we rotated the problematic nodes out for replacement.

Impact on you: requests routed to the fallback may have slightly lower vector quality (quantized model). No customer data was exposed; logs show no anomalous queries. We will follow up with an automated report including request counts and error rates on your account.

If you want a tailored follow-up or post-mortem, reply here or open a private thread and we will prioritize.

– Lina, Customer Success (Redwood)
```

pm-maya: add SLO note: mark as "partial availability impact"; legal requested if customer-facing incident > 30m to loop in compliance. This was ~16m, so ok for standard follow-up, escalate if Helios requests more.

oncall-alex: short timeline for status page update:
- 12:02 UTC — auto-detect 5xx spike (INC-1751012345)
- 12:07 UTC — scale + reroute initiated
- 12:18 UTC — error rate <5%, fallback serving handling traffic
- 12:25 UTC — replaced nodes and confirmed stable

Impacted accounts (observed request/error correlation): Helios Labs (all embeddings calls routed), NovaThera (subset of embeddings during heavy batch job), TidalHealth (occasional retries). Recommended targets for tailored notices: Helios Labs (full), NovaThera (partial).

oncall-alex: handing over monitoring to @oncall-sam for night shift. Leaving runbook pointers and metrics pinned.

oncall-sam: ack takeover. I'll keep an eye on the 5m/1m error-rate graphs and CPU/GPU memory. Please DM me if CS sends any escalation requests; I'll be on-call until 04:00 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated at 12:25 UTC after node replacement and traffic normalization. Auto-close conditions satisfied; keeping thread open for CS confirmation.

cs-lina: sending Helios notice now via enterprise channel and recording in customer ticket #CH-8372. Will post status page update link once published.

cs-lina: status page update published: https://status.redwood.ai/2023/12/embeddings-incident-1751012345 — included tailored Helios blurb and public timeline.

oncall-sam: thanks — monitoring continues for 45m. If we get >3% error rate again we reopen escalation. :thumbsup:
